'''Adlène Hicheur''' (born 4 December 1976)<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20100601184138/http://www.timesonline.co.uk/tol/news/world/europe/article6871774.ece Hadron Collider physicist Adlene Hicheur charged with terrorism], ''[[The Times]]'', 13 October 2009</ref> is a [[particle physicist]] with dual [[Algeria]]n and [[France|French]] nationality.<ref>[http://www.csis.org/files/publication/TTU_0708.pdf Transnational threat update], ''[[Center for Strategic and International Studies]]'',  October 2009</ref> After his master of theoretical physics in Lyon, he joined [http://lappweb.in2p3.fr/LAPP2004/ LAPP] (Laboratoire d'Annecy le Vieux de Physique des Particules) to work on the [[BaBar experiment]], located at the [[Stanford Linear Accelerator Center]]. His thesis, defended in 2003, was about the production of high energy [[Eta prime meson]]s in the decays of [[B meson]]s. After that he was a Postdoctorate in England at the [[Rutherford Appleton Laboratory]], where he worked on the [[ATLAS experiment]] at LHC. He then joined the high energy physics department of [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]] (EPFL) and works currently on the [[LHCb]] experiment.

Adlène Hicheur was arrested in France on 8 October 2009, after police allegedly intercepted emails between himself and [[Al-Qaida in Islamic Maghreb]], an Algerian-based terrorist organisation. Two weeks after his arrest, the Algerian media<ref>[http://www.lejourdalgerie.com/Editions/171009/Rubriques/evenement.htm#3 Adlène Hicheur: Une seconde affaire Raïssi ?] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091020020127/http://www.lejourdalgerie.com/Editions/171009/Rubriques/evenement.htm#3 |date=October 20, 2009 }}, ''Le jour d'Algérie'', 17 October 2009</ref> compared Hicheur to [[Lotfi Raissi]], who was first suspected of terrorism before being released without charges. An International Support Committee was organized by Adlene's friends and colleagues<ref name="pagesperso-orange1">[http://soutien.hicheur.pagesperso-orange.fr/ Comité international de soutien à Adlène Hicheur]</ref> to support Adlene and to request a fair investigation.

General director of the [[National Police (France)|National Police]] [[Frédéric Péchenard]] stated in November 2009 that Hicheur planned to attack a base of the National Defence in [[Annecy]], which harbours the [[27ème bataillon de chasseurs alpins]], involved in Afghanistan.<ref>[http://www.lemonde.fr/europe/article/2009/11/17/l-ingenieur-du-cern-soupconne-de-terrorisme-ciblait-les-chasseurs-alpins_1268185_3214.html L'ingénieur du CERN soupçonné de terrorisme ciblait les chasseurs alpins], lemonde.fr, 17 November 2009</ref>

Hicheur's trial started on 29 March 2012 in Paris.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-17554653|title=French Cern scientist goes on trial for 'al-Qaeda plot'|work=BBC News|date=29 March 2012}}</ref> In May 2012 Hicheur was sentenced to "five years in prison for plotting terrorist attacks."<ref>{{Cite news | title = France jails physicist for terror | work = BBC | accessdate = 2012-05-04 | date = 2012-05-04 | url = https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-17956202 }}</ref> On 15 May Hicheur left prison and decided not to appeal against his sentence.<ref>{{Cite news | title = Physicist convicted of terrorism leaves prison | work = Physics World | accessdate = 2012-05-16 | date = 2012-05-16 | url = http://physicsworld.com/cws/article/news/2012/may/16/physicist-convicted-of-terrorism-leaves-prison }}</ref> He was a visiting professor at ''Instituto de Física'' of [[Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro]], [[Rio de Janeiro]], Brazil.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://epoca.globo.com/tempo/noticia/2016/01/exclusivo-um-terrorista-no-brasil.html |title = Exclusivo: Um terrorista no Brasil}}</ref>

In July 2016, the government of Brazil had Hicheur deported back to France,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2016-07-16 |title=Brazil Deports Franco-Algerian Nuclear Physicist |url=https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/07/16/world/americas/ap-lt-brazil-physicist-deported.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160716173742/https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/07/16/world/americas/ap-lt-brazil-physicist-deported.html |archive-date=2016-07-16 |website=New York Times}}</ref> where he was placed under house arrest.<ref name="Nature">{{cite journal|url=http://www.nature.com/news/lhc-scientists-bring-conference-to-deported-physicist-1.21155|title=LHC scientists bring conference to deported physicist|journal=Nature|date=13 December 2016|doi=10.1038/nature.2016.21155|last1=Butler|first1=Declan|s2cid=126188979|url-access=subscription}}</ref> Hicheur has decided to renounce his French citizenship and move to Algeria.<ref name="Nature" />
